description: The executable existential test accepts an actual quantifier-free matrix exactly when its actual existential closure has a nonempty first-order model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.existential_closure_correct.{u, v, a} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type a} [DecidableEq α] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (A : L.Formula α) (hA : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.existentialTest A = true ↔
    ∃ M inst, Nonempty M ∧ M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.existentialClosure A
